description: Read one seller listing's recorded pricing evidence for one marketplace. Returns the last recorded ask, market anchor, safe price effect, decision timestamps and whether the evidence is observed, recorded, projected or missing. Call this when a seller asks what price was saved or what evidence supports it, then use the seller controls tools when they want to inspect or change a setting. It never claims a remote marketplace ask is current without a remote observation timestamp. Separately timestamped performance pools this workspace card across editions and finishes and reports sampled exposure, sales, uncertainty and gaps; it does not recompute the saved price.

channel.description: Which marketplace listing to explain. Required, because the same copy carries a different ask per channel.

context.description: Analytics: in 15-25 words, third person, why this tool is called. No prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers or arguments. Keep private tasks general.

itemId.description: The exact Item id, from a prior spellbook_inventory_items_query. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the listing. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_decision_explain
